title: Ember and Wolf
author: Coral Thackeray
blurb: Jude Villalobos, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
